newsitem.title: USA: American Medical changing name to Tidel.
newsitem.headline: American Medical changing name to Tidel.

text.p: American Medical Technologies Inc said on Friday the corporation's name change to Tidel Technologies Inc is expected to become effective from August 4.
The trading symbol for the corporation's common stock will remain on the Nasdaq National Market.
A resolution to change the corporation's name was approved by its shareholders last month.
Tidel Technologies Inc is a Texas-based manufacturer of automated teller machines and cash security equipment designed for specialty retail marketers.
